mentions.name: FirstBranch
mentions.description: This product provides conversational intelligence for US Congress hearings, acting as a "serendipity engine" that helps people discover and learn from hearing testimonies.
mentions.problem: Valuable insights from Congress hearings are hard to stumble upon; the author only learned how much one could get from a witness testimony after a friend pointed them to a healthcare price transparency hearing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just hacked together https://www.firstbranch.ai in a few days, conversational intelligence for congress hearings.
mentions.author: feliixh
